title: Block Says Most Bitcoin Payments on Square Are for Coffee and Food
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Block Says Most Bitcoin Payments on Square Are for Coffee and Food Block’s first bitcoin payments report found the median Square payment is about $13, with 72% at food and drink businesses, as it pushes for a de minimis tax exemption. This post Block Says Most Bitcoin Payments on Square Are for Coffee and Food first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
